title: Traces table grouped-session header: column renderSessionCell aggregates child traces; sum only fields that are present
answers: Collapsed grouped session row in the V4 Traces table shows a blank Tokens cell instead of a total
Where are the per-session values for a traces table column computed?
How do I add a session-level summary to a column when traces are grouped by session?
Why does a session token count skip traces that have no usage data instead of counting them as zero?
body:
Path: Traces V4 table in grouped-by-session mode. Each standard column's optional renderSessionCell in columns.tsx:STANDARD_COLUMNS receives all child traces of a session and fills the collapsed session header row rendered by TracesTable.tsx:TracesTable.
Rule: Put session-level aggregation in renderSessionCell on the column def, not in the per-trace cell. The Tokens column uses TraceCell.tsx:SessionTokensCell, which sums input, output and total counts separately. A field stays undefined only when every child lacks it, so a missing count is not turned into 0. Single-trace and session displays share TraceCell.tsx:TokenUsageCell, so formatting stays identical.
Symptom: In a collapsed grouped session the Tokens header cell was empty, though the child traces carried token counts.
Constraints: Applies to aggregates over the traces passed to the session row. Does not apply to ungrouped rows. Whether the aggregate is complete for a session that spans pages is handled separately (see the sessionsMayBeIncomplete note).
applies: Traces V4 table, grouped-by-session view, session header aggregates for standard columns.
says: Collapsed session row in the traces table shows an empty token usage cell

search: In the Traces V4 table grouped-by-session view, standard column definitions in columns.tsx:STANDARD_COLUMNS compute session header aggregates using renderSessionCell, rendered in TracesTable.tsx:TracesTable. For the Tokens column, TraceCell.tsx:SessionTokensCell aggregates input, output, and total counts separately, keeping a field undefined only when all child traces lack it and formatting via TokenUsageCell. This aggregation applies strictly to grouped session header rows and does not affect ungrouped rows or cross-page completeness handling.
